scope: One archived camp repair machine; source-qualified metadata, no gameplay service or PECS format change.

excluded.name: Knife
excluded.exclusion: source camp UI requires a nonempty repair material list

excluded.name: Rope Gun
excluded.exclusion: source camp UI requires a nonempty repair material list

excluded.name: Safety Axe
excluded.exclusion: source camp UI requires a nonempty repair material list

interaction.range: Root has no PeTrans; CollectColliders finds the one enabled nontrigger root box; inclusive Bounds.SqrDistance <= 19 squared after root-axis rough filter.
interaction.transform: Prefab root identity; archived yaw180 quaternion retained, root localScale reset to one by OperatableItemRepairMachine.Init/PostInit.
interaction.source_pointer: MousePicker enabled and not gamePause; UICamera.hoveredObject blocks; delayTime0 requires positive hover elapsed; nearest Level0 pick in source obstacle distance+10.
interaction.source_operation: InteractWithItem Click or OpenItemMenu ClickNoMove calls Operate; the latter also dispatches RMouseClickEvent.
interaction.native_adapter: Supported crop, loaded model/current collision, living player within inclusive8m root range; strict tree-free geometry occlusion with .0001m equality tolerance. No source +10m through-wall allowance.

semantics.cost: ceil(base material count * 1 * (1 - durability/max)); active UI has no epsilon early return
semantics.start_gate: Repair exists and !PeFloatRangeNum.IsCurrentMax(); absolute deficit < PEMath.Epsilon counts as full
semantics.time: base * pow(.82,worker_count) * product(1-worker_skill); qualified camp has zero assigned workers
semantics.timer: Per enabled CounterScript display Update: remaining ticks += trunc(float(-1 * dt * 100000)); completion at <=0; independent of accelerated world clock
semantics.insert: Transfer the same instance out of its former owner; busy machine rejects insertion/extraction; source equipment origin can unequip
semantics.replace: Same category exchanges instances; otherwise return old only after CanAdd succeeds, then insert new
semantics.cancel: StopCounter sets current0/final-1, destroys counter, retains item and does not refund consumed materials
semantics.close: OnClose clears UI binding only; item and job remain owned by machine; distance>8 closes UI
semantics.complete: Optional UI callback then Repairing->Repair.Do; same instance set to maximum, remains in machine; repeated Do is idempotent
semantics.saved: CSDataMgr MainAdventure creator10000 -> CSRepairData entity20006: independent item instance ID/current/final; ItemMgr separately saves actual item
semantics.restore: CSRepair.CreateData resolves stored instance via ItemMgr and restarts nonnegative final counter; empty -1 final does not start
semantics.limitation: Both archived jobs are empty. Source establishes restart path; no observed nonempty/partial job save or exact cross-MonoBehaviour update order is claimed.

exclusions: No LifeLimit, creation, worker colony, arbitrary repair machine placement, service UI, inventory transfer or save integration is enabled.
Knife33 and SafetyAxe1527 have no source repair materials and must not receive free repairs.
Native atomic preflight/commit, bag-only admission and pause/clock scheduling require explicit implementation policies.
Source and installed static machine components agree; rendered active machine animation remains outside this metadata extraction.
